notes.title: Blub Emporium 1.3.0 has appeared!
notes.content:
[h3]After a lot of work, here is version 1.3.0![/h3]
This update turned out to be quite a bit larger than I had initially planned. So here I'll [b]sum up some of the features this new update brings[/b]. Note that the normal change notes can be found at the bottom of this announcement.

[h3]The Star of the Show - The Blub-o-pedia![/h3]
A primary driving force for this update to come out was to introduce the Blub-o-pedia, which is essentially an encyclopedia built into the game from scratch. I had to make an in-game browser that could handle a myriad of pages I wrote, outlining nearly everything I know about the game. This definitely took a bulk of my time, but in the end is something I'm very happy with and will hopefully serve everyone well.

The Blub-o-pedia features a page about every single functional item, every resource, and every mechanic the game features. Each page has clickable hyperlinks that will redirect you to other pages, and even includes pictures and captions to help with explanations.

The advantages of an in-game guide are numerous; You can access it without opening another window and without internet, the pages can pull data live from the game for the most accurate information, the look and feel of it can be consistent with the rest of the game, and importantly you can access pages directly from a multitude of places from within the game itself.

[b]Accessing Blub-o-pedia pages:[/b]
Blub-o-pedia pages can be accessed conveniently from many places in the UI of the game. Any time an item is selected in any way (including focusing on them, selecting them in build mode, selecting them in the inventory, or viewing their Catalogue pages) the Blub-o-pedia button (or shortcut, [b][F2][/b] by default) can be pressed to instantly bring up its respective Blub-o-pedia page. This makes it extremely easy to find out information about what an item does, and any relevant other tips or items that pair well with it.

Resource icons in the resources tab can also be pressed to bring up their respective B-O-P page, which makes it trivial to find out what you can do with a particular resource or how to get more if it.
[previewyoutube=iv-i6429Xpg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]The Artefact Table and Artefacts![/h3]
After level 25 you will now get the Artefact Table. This item permits various Artefacts to be placed above it to reap different benefits, and consequently some side effects. Many of these last forever, but some are limited.

An example is the Artefact of Greed, which increases money earnings by 25%, but halves all experience income. There's also the Artefact of Destruction which causes debris on the Farm to be demolished extremely quickly at the cost of losing half of their potential yields.
There's 8 other Artefacts in the game, each with a side effect and/or limits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40515513/a8389ca85dc87075a967a788e181d7aade692db7.png[/img]

[h3]New Stock Types (and a Terrain!)[/h3]
This update brings Bones and Paint! Bones are a simple resource type obtained by harvesting Bone Piles that spawn on the new Cracked Dirt terrain. Paint is a later-game manufactured Resource made of an Iron Bar, Water, Latex Sap, and Pigment. It comes with its own auto-stocker (the Paint Roller).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40515513/7abbe2eafbfaca21d60e852a9209b092421c919d.png[/img]

[h3]Puzzle box Four![/h3]
At last, the fourth Puzzle Box (well, fifth!) has been introduced. It's quite predictably, a little harder than Puzzle Box Three, and like all Puzzle Boxes, it comes with its own unique unlock (the Treasure Chest!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40515513/deaab4210eb07fa3a7a3c5846beeaa89088ca040.png[/img]

[h3]New boost items[/h3]
The Lucky Sugarcane is introduced in this update, helping with Sugarcane yields. Along with that is the Mystical Orb to make Mystic Shards significantly less of an issue. And a buff to the Bottlebrush Tree making it go from doubling to tripling Mulch production.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40515513/2073f26363b1ee314541f8155dd4e8eac8e75b36.png[/img]

[h3]New Checkouts, Tables, Chairs, and Decorations[/h3]
Two new unique checkouts come in this update: the Antique Checkout and the Alchemy Checkout!
Many other new decorations appear in this update, like the Floaty Penguin, Boombox, and Flower Clusters. As well as a range of awesome Fancy Tables and Chairs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40515513/0d0a33ac4634259b937606b5045f8d048e66a44b.png[/img]

[h3]New event[/h3]
The Blub Tea Party is here!!! For those advanced enough you can try and score high in an event focused on selling loads of Mugs of Tea.

[h3]UI Improvements[/h3]
By default, levelling up will now show you a list of all noteworthy items you unlock. If you have previously played, this will be left on "show acquisitions", which can be changed in the settings.
Mantled items will no longer show at all in the game unless they have been explicitly discovered, making it feasible to 100% the catalogue without them.

[h3]Extra tasks, fixes, tweaks, and so much more[/h3]
This is by no means an exhaustive list of changes, there is so much more. Be sure to check out the Blub-o-pedia and everything else the game has to offer! :)

[h3]Normal change log below[/h3]

notes.title: What have I been up to? - Introducing Huecube!
notes.content:
G'day all!
You may have noticed Blub Emporium has been enjoying a comfortable rest as far as updates go, why is this? Well as you may know I am one man, so I can only do so much at once. I have been hard at work on fleshing out another project which started its life around the same time as Blub Emporium did originally.

- [b]What's happening with [u]Blub Emporium[/u]?[/b]
Blub Emporium is in a great state, but I'm still not officially done with it. I absolutely plan to do more updates for it, adding more items and quality of life features! I have to balance my attention between BE and my other projects, so I can't release updates as fast, but I will always strive to keep them to my standard of quality.

- [b]New game? Tell us more![/b]
The new game in question is "Huecube", it's a puzzle platformer with super smooth and satisfying movement featuring the abilities to [b]manipulate time[/b] (having a recording of your past self help you solve fantastic puzzles, or vice versa) and [b]colour shift[/b] (adding and subtracting colours to your cube to help clear gaps or phase through walls).
The game has a fully integrated and extensive level editor tool to allow players to create their own Huecube levels of any style, be it a parkour/obstacle course, a head-scratching puzzle, or a creative contraption using the in-depth wiring system and the many ways players can interact with them. Levels can be submitted to the Steam workshop to be played by other players!

To sum up, Blub Emporium will see more updates, and a brand new game solo developed by myself once again is up on Steam, and I implore you to go give the page a look, and maybe even add it to your Steam wishlist (this helps me out a tonne!).

Click [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2555980/Huecube/]here[/url] to view the store page for Huecube, or alternatively search for "Huecube" in your Steam client's store.

notes.title: Blub Emporium's 1 Year Anniversary!
notes.content:
[b]Already?![/b]
This year has absolutely flown, and I only know that because apparently it was this time last year that Blub Emporium was officially released here on Steam!

In-game you'll be able to get yourself the "Release Cake" (Seasonal Item) from the Catalogue to put in your Emporium and celebrate with the Blubs!

I just wanted to give a huge thank you for everyone who has bought, played and supported Blub Emporium since its release! It's by no means a huge hit of a game, but for every single person who's given it a go and maybe even loved it, makes it a hit in my eyes! :) I'm working hard on other things behind the scenes, and I do plan to still deliver updates for Blub Emporium here and there.

May your days be as merry as a Blub and its 83 rubber ducks at home.

- Riley

[b][u]Blub Emporium Version 1.2.4[/u] - [/b]Change Log

This update brings much needed improvements to the Factory, including an extremely easy way of loading different Factory layouts, conveyor belts that allow power to pass through, the ability to at last buy Laterators at will, and a way to quickly copy placed items to the cursor for convenience!
Overall the game sees some further QoL improvements + balance, and another mega shelf variant!

[b]ITEMS AND RESOURCES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added "Wired Conveyor" (Factory Other).
[*] Added "Lunar Balloons" (Emporium Deco).
[*] Added "Stock Box" (Emporium Special).
[*] Added "Bottlebrush Tree" (Farm Special).
[*] Added "Jumbo Calculator" (Emporium Special).
[*] Added "Mega Boomerang Rack" (Shelves).
[/list]

[b]UI:[/b]
[list]
[*] The task menu will now automatically re-open after a task reward has been collected (can be disabled).
[*] Pressing the interact button (default: E) when cursor is over a placed (factory) ground item (and isn't placing anything) will quickly jump to it in your inventory (effectively a pipette tool).
[*] Pressing the interact button when an item IS selected will cause the cursor to be cleared (effectively emulating escape to cancel placing items).
[*] Some sub-menus in the Main Menu now remember the page you were on, this means you don't need to navigate back when changing settings found on latter pages. 
[*] Added ability to quick load and quick design schematics in the Factory.
	Four buttons will appear on the left above the build hammer as you unlock the schematic slots,
	selecting these will attempt to load previously saved schematics immediately if possible, at the spot they were saved.
	
	Holding function (LCTRL by default) and selecting these buttons will immediately save the current Factory design as that schematic,
	saving the hassle of locating your Schematic Savers and placing them in order to save a design.
	Note that the corresponding Schematic Saver and/or Loader must be owned to use their respective quick save/load features.
	
	If a schematic file has its "title" tag set, it will show up in parentheses besides the "Ready!" text (otherwise will default to the colour of the loader).
	Using the new "E" Pick-item feature on these buttons will select their respective schematic device from your inventory.
	
[/list]

[*] Added "Boomerang Mastery" Task Track.

notes.title: Blub Emporium Update Notes - Version Beta 1L
notes.content:
[u][b]Blub Emporium Beta 1L[/b][/u]

[b]ITEMS AND RESOURCES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added "Empty Button" (Factory Other).
[*] Added "Triverter" (Factory Other).
[*] Added "Huge Flowers" (Emporium Special).
[*] Added "Titanium Weave" (Factory Tile).
[/list]

[b]VISUAL:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added visual feedback to "clicking" with the keyboard cursor.
[*] Changed the emporium, farm and factory theme colours for the classic UI theme.
[*] Decreased the saturation of the pop-up overlay colours in the classic UI theme.
[*] Added locational indicator colour strip that appears in the shop, showing the ui theme colour for each location that a category belongs to.
[*] Added hard background colouring to the shop focus menus.
[*] Added visual glow effect to the page buttons in the shop to stand out more.
[*] Added pulse button movement effect that occurs when the page arrows are pressed in the shop.
[*] Added coloured strip that lays behind the wheel spin animation to tie it in with the new shop UI.
[*] Slightly changed the pixel alignment of alerts to prevent tiny discrepancies between sprites.
[*] Added occlusion to the emporium and factory as a whole against the grassy platform.
[*] Made the tutorial text box have a heavier dark backing colour to make the text easier to distinguish.
[*] Added text highlighting to key words in the tutorial.
[/list]

[b]UI:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed "{" and "}" from being used in emporium save titles.
[*] Added new inventory tabs for more convenient sorting: "Hoppers", "Processors", (Factory) "Other".
[*] Changed where the emporium decoration tab is positioned in the tab hierarchy.
[*] Made the shop's categories location-dependent, with a setting to revert them to their old "global" state (or function-opening shop).
[*] Added secondary tooltip to the shop to inform the player about what categories will be viewable upon opening it.
[*] Added brand new tasks system, replacing the old quests. Multiple task tracks can be done simultaneously and each task rewards money, xp and an unlock or free item(s).
[*] Changed task list to show completed and available tasks on it.
[/list]

[b]GAMEPLAY/BALANCE:[/b]
[list]
[*] Strawberry bushes now act like nodes and will be demolished after their yield limit has ran out.
[*] Decreased the capacity of containers: 100 -> 80.
[*] Decreased value of strawberry bush sprouts to reflect their now impermanency: 450 -> 325.
[*] Changed the level experience requirement curve to be significantly less steep later, at the cost of the slightest increase earlier on.
[*] Retired original method of obtaining the Totem of the Cosmos, Cosmic Vase, Amethyst Liquidator, Amethyst Hopper and Amethyst Pyramid in favour of integrating them into a task track.
[*] Completely re-did the entire tutorial, now running more thoroughly through several mechanics and introducing the task list.
[/list]

[b]BUGS/TECHNICAL:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the resource menu closing if scrolling with the keyboard cursor enabled was attempted.
[*] Corrected the missing importer alerts.
[*] Fixed bug where sealed pipes and construction lights would let light through them if a wire was behind
[*] Optimised the rendering pipeline for lighting in the factory (making lighting only queue when rebaking).
[*] Fixed factory lighting bug where lights would randomly appear through items that should be occluding it (was caused by a computer floating point inconsistency in the shader).
[*] Fixed bug where hovering a non-interactable item when editmode is closed would cause it to render on top of other things it was obscured by briefly.
[*] Made the factory update order consistent with an update rule of top to bottom, left to right, rather than being volatile and ocassionally random with items sharing a cartesianal row.
[*] Reconfigured conveyor belts to have a consistent precedence rule relative to their orientation; i.e. they allow items from the rear first, then left, then right.
[*] Fixed item teleportation desync visual bug that happened ocassionally in the factory.
[*] Changed the reset button to become unusable while the button is compressed.
[*] Changed both the multi-harvester and multi-reaper to use the "use" button rather than the "activate" toggle.
[*] Made shop reset its offset when opened so that previous sessions don't carry over.
[*] Altered the iternals of inventory to include zero as a tab to prevent certain issues.
[*] Fixed bug where using the prize wheel would cause any offer blubs to instantly rejoice and leave as if their offer was accepted.
[*] Fixed bug letting the zoom tooltip show through other UI elements if your zoom was min/max.
[*] Removed erroneous alert showing gumball machine unlock via level-up which is no longer possible.
[*] Corrected the arctic blue padded stool labelling itself as a pale blue padded stool in the catalogue.
[*] Added separate hour counters for the three locations.
[/list]

[b]MISC:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added phrase ender character for cosmic script.
[*] Changed the default "default camera zoom" setting to be 2X rather than the minimum (1x).
[*] Renamed the quest list to the "Task List", better reflecting its nature.
[*] Added a phrase written in cosmic script viewable when focusing on the cosmic checkout.
[*] Added additional jingle that plays when a task is completed.
[*] Changed camera to stop all momentum when pop-ups are opened to stop the camera strangely resuming movement after.
[*] Renamed shop to the catalogue to make better sense to its purpose as one.
[*] Changed sale counting special items to state "counts <item> sales" rather than just "counts <items>".
[*] Slightly increased the duration of silence after the tutorial: 1s -> 3s.
[*] Skipping the tutorial no longer shows mass alerts for items.
[*] Slightly altered wording for role in credits.
[*] Altered desc of task list to fit its current name.
[*] Added "Falling Aslumber" to the primary music pool.
[*] Added "Everything Gold" achievement.
[/list]
